title: No act or proceeding of the Central Authority shall be invalid merely by reason of any vacancy, defect in constitution,

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint with the Central Authority, but there is a vacancy in the Central Authority or a defect in the constitution of the Central Authority. The consumer is concerned that the act or proceeding of the Central Authority may be invalid due to this vacancy or defect.
content.outcome: The act or proceeding of the Central Authority shall not be invalid merely by reason of any vacancy, defect in constitution, defect in appointment of a person acting as the Chief Commissioner or as a Commissioner, or irregularity in procedure not affecting the merits of the case.

user_queries: What happens if there is a vacancy in the Central Authority?
Can a defect in the constitution of the Central Authority make an act or proceeding invalid?
How does an irregularity in procedure affect the validity of an act or proceeding of the Central Authority?
